newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Analog Devices estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Analog Devices estimate cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Gus Richard cut his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate on Analog Devices Inc to $1.08 a share on revenue of $1.31 billion from a previous $1.14 a share on sales of 1.37 billion.

-- In a statement, Richard noted Analog Devices on Wednesday reported a profit of $0.23 a share for fiscal 1997's first quarter ended February 1. He said the figure was $0.02 per share below Hambrecht's estimate and $0.03 per share below the Street consensus.
-- Strong orders in January and early February, however, seem to reflect an upturn in market demand, he said.
